# DressYou

> Try it on before it's yours.
> DressYou makes a twin from your own photos, so you can try on clothes from any shop, your wardrobe or the feed before you buy.

DressYou Technologies is a Paris-based fashion technology company. This site presents the
DressYou app: a twin made from your own photos, try-ons from a shop link, your wardrobe or the
feed, outfit building from the clothes you own, asking friends to vote between looks, and a
stylist that answers from your wardrobe and your taste. The app is not yet released; iOS,
Android and a browser extension are announced.

The people shown on the site are AI-generated.

## Facts

- Name: DressYou
- Company: DressYou Technologies, 47 rue Vivienne, 75002 Paris, France
- Tagline: Try it on before it's yours.
- Website: https://dressyouapp.com/
- Contact: hello@dressyouapp.com
- Status: pre-launch
